messages:
alice: Heads up — CI showed a large artifact size regression for the serving runtime after the attention_v2_opt change, ~+18% on gpu-linux build. anyone else seeing this?
ben: I saw that too, great catch. quick question: is this the fatbin or the host lib that grew?
ci-bot: Build #4721 finished. Artifacts: runtime-gpu.tar.gz (was 42.1MB -> now 49.8MB, +18.3%). Upload: s3://redwood-artifacts/runtime/4721/runtime-gpu.tar.gz
priya: Looks like the fatbin section in the shared object increased. cuobjdump -lelf shows extra cubin sections for sm_86 + sm_90.
marco: That makes sense — attention_v2_opt introduced a tiled kernel with an extra PTX fallback. Possibly nvcc emitted both PTX and cubin for multiple gencode entries.
alice: current nvcc line in CI: `nvcc -O3 -Xcompiler -fPIC -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -gencode=arch=compute_90,code=sm_90 -lineinfo -Xptxas=-v -rdc=true`
ben: -lineinfo + multiple -gencode entries will bloat fatbins. Also check if we're building with `-g` or debug symbols accidentally.
priya: Confirmed: build matrix includes a debug variant for local testing that accidentally got enabled in CI for this commit because of the env toggle. That added relocatable device code and prevented LTO from stripping unused kernels.
marco: Quick experiment idea: rebuild with `-Xlinker --strip-debug` or post-process `.so` with `elvx`/strip to remove host debug. For device sections we can use `cuobjcopy --strip` (we currently have a small helper script for that).
alice: ran a local rebuild with `--strip-all` on host and `cuobjcopy --strip` on fatbin: size drops to +6% instead of +18%. So definitely device sections are major chunk.
ben: Longer-term: consider reducing redundant gencode entries. We currently compile for sm_86 and sm_90 by default; maybe produce PTX only for one and cubin for the other to avoid duplicates. Or use `code="compute_90,sm_90"` patterns to prefer PTX-only where acceptable.
priya: Also worth checking `-rdc=true` usage. Enabling relocatable device code forces separate compilation units and can inflate artifact size. Is `-rdc` necessary for the tiled kernel?
marco: It's used for device-side function pointers in the tiled path. Could refactor to avoid `-rdc` (longer refactor) or keep `-rdc` but enable kernel trimming via `nvlink --relocatable-device-code=false` in release builds. Need to validate runtime behavior.
alice: Action items: 1) Temporary CI hotfix: add post-build strip stage for device sections (ci:acceptance script). 2) Short-term: disable debug variant in CI matrix for release artifacts. 3) Medium-term: investigate gencode list + `-rdc` tradeoffs and refactor tiled kernel to remove `-rdc` if possible.
ben: I'll open a PR for the CI hotfix (strip stage + size-gate threshold bump for this commit).
ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/891 — includes `scripts/strip_device_sections.sh` and new size-gate check (10% transient allowance).
priya: For the size-gate, let's not silently allow 10% forever — add a regression label and expire the allowance after 24h so the author can follow up.
marco: Good call. Also adding an automated `cuobjdump -lelf` artifact in CI to surface cubin/PTX counts would help root-cause fast.
alice: Agree. Could we also add a small test that runs `cuobjdump` and fails if there are duplicate cubin entries for the same kernel name? Cheap heuristic but useful.
ben: I'll prototype that test in the PR. If it passes CI, we merge hotfix and then start the refactor RFC for removing `-rdc` dependency in attention tiled path.
priya: FYI: upstream nvcc behavior changed between CUDA 11->12 for `-gencode` deduping; we should pin the toolchain matrix in the ticket so changes in toolkit don't surprise us later.
alice: Definitely. I'll file an RFC follow-up linking the PR, the cuobjdump logs, and the plan to pin/validate CUDA toolkit versions in CI.
marco: TL;DR: root cause = multiple gencode/cubin outputs + relocatable device code + debug symbols. Mitigation = strip device sections in CI + disable debug variant + add cuobjdump diagnostics. Long-term = reduce gencode duplication or remove `-rdc` usage via refactor. :white_check_mark:
alice: Thanks all — Ben, Priya, Marco, please cross-post status to the eng-infra channel after PR merge so oncall knows CI behavior change.
ben: Will do. :thumbsup:
